item.title: Cities halt live-streaming council meetings, sparking transparency, accessibility concerns
item.description: The COVID-19 pandemic forced city governments to get creative to allow citizens to still partake in city council meetings. That's why many began live-streaming council meetings online. Cities and towns used Facebook, YouTube or their municipal websites to share live viewings for citizens who were unable to attend in person.
